		options             []containers.Option[StoreOptions]
		wantArtifactType    string
		wantConfigMediaType string
	}{
		{
			name:                "default is 1.1",
			wantArtifactType:    MediaTypeFliptFeatures,
			wantConfigMediaType: v1.MediaTypeEmptyJSON,
		},
		{
			name:                "explicit 1.0",
			options:             []containers.Option[StoreOptions]{WithManifestVersion(oras.PackManifestVersion1_0)},
			wantConfigMediaType: MediaTypeFliptFeatures,
		},
		{
			name:                "explicit 1.1",
			options:             []containers.Option[StoreOptions]{WithManifestVersion(oras.PackManifestVersion1_1)},
			wantArtifactType:    MediaTypeFliptFeatures,
			wantConfigMediaType: v1.MediaTypeEmptyJSON,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx := context.Background()
			dir := t.TempDir()
			store, err := NewStore(zaptest.NewLogger(t), dir, tt.options...)
			require.NoError(t, err)

			ref, err := ParseReference("flipt://local/" + repo + ":latest")
			require.NoError(t, err)
			files, err := fs.Sub(testdata, "testdata")
			require.NoError(t, err)

			bundle, err := store.Build(ctx, files, ref)
			require.NoError(t, err)

			manifestBytes, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, repo, "blobs", "sha256", bundle.Digest.Hex()))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			var manifest v1.Manifest
			require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(manifestBytes, &manifest))
			require.Equal(t, tt.wantArtifactType, manifest.ArtifactType)
			require.Equal(t, tt.wantConfigMediaType, manifest.Config.MediaType)
			require.Len(t, manifest.Layers, 2)
		})
	}
}

Implemented `storage.oci.manifest_version` with values `"1.0"` and `"1.1"`, a `"1.1"` default, and the required validation error for unsupported values. Bundle creation now uses the configured version through [WithManifestVersion](/app/internal/oci/file.go); both the [bundle command](/app/cmd/flipt/bundle.go) and [OCI storage path](/app/internal/storage/fs/store/store.go) pass it to the store.

Three native subagents handled the configuration, OCI option, and manifest tests; I integrated the callers and final validation. Configuration, schema, OCI, and affected package tests passed. The tests verify the generated 1.0 and 1.1 manifests; no live ECR push was run.
